panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Panel A shows the consequence of the obstruction (dilated loops of small bowel) within the pelvic region, consistent with the documented obturator hernia. B: Panel B explicitly visualizes the small bowel loop interposed between the pectineus and obturator musculature, which is the defining radiological characteristic of this hernia type. C: Panel C similarly visualizes the small bowel loop interposed within the obturator canal area, confirming the diagnosis.

panels.figure_caption: Sequential axial images from contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis demonstrate: (A) dilated loops of small bowel in the pelvis; (B) and (C) loop of small bowel (red X) interposed between the pectineus (blue arrow) and obturator musculature (green arrow). The obturator canal is widened and measures approximately 2.5 cm.
